<mxGeometry height="10" width="87.5" x="771.5" y="370" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="su38blvhCA2a_bY0gaeY-39" parent="1" style="shape=trapezoid;perimeter=trapezoidPerimeter;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fixedSize=1;strokeWidth=2;rounded=1;shadow=0;fillColor=#e1d5e7;strokeColor=#9673a6;" value="<b>Temperature Regulator</b>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="21" width="230" x="539" y="463" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="su38blvhCA2a_bY0gaeY-42" parent="1" style="text;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fontFamily=Comic Sans MS;" value="<p data-start="137" data-end="327"><font style="font-size: 14px;" face="Georgia">The innovative study chair integrates a posture-correction cushion, a detachable headrest, and a main chair body with multiple smart features, all designed to enhance learning efficiency.</font></p><p data-start="333" data-end="898"><font style="font-size: 14px;" face="Georgia">The <strong data-start="337" data-end="349">headrest</strong> contains <strong data-start="359" data-end="392">active noise cancelling (ANC)</strong>, which reduces surrounding noise by producing sound waves with opposite phases, demonstrating the principle of <strong data-start="504" data-end="525">wave interference</strong>. It also includes a <strong data-start="546" data-end="557">speaker</strong> for lectures or music, which works by converting electrical signals into vibrations that create sound waves. The <strong data-start="671" data-end="696">temperature regulator</strong> maintains comfort by measuring temperature changes and adjusting heat, based on <strong data-start="777" data-end="805">heat transfer principles</strong>, and a <strong data-start="813" data-end="832">vibration motor</strong> provides tactile feedback to correct posture or deliver alarms.</font></p><p data-start="904" data-end="1381"><font style="font-size: 14px;" face="Georgia">The <strong data-start="908" data-end="938">posture-correction cushion</strong> uses <strong data-start="944" data-end="964">pressure sensors</strong> to detect how the user sits, converting applied forces into electrical signals to give <strong data-start="1052" data-end="1073">AI-based feedback</strong>, helping maintain proper spinal alignment. It also has temperature control to keep the optimal range of 20–26°C for concentration. Both the cushion and headrest support <strong data-start="1243" data-end="1268">Qi2 wireless charging</strong>, which works on the principle of <strong data-start="1302" data-end="1331">electromagnetic induction</strong>, and are detachable for use in other locations.</font></p><p data-start="1387" data-end="1800"><font style="font-size: 14px;" face="Georgia">Additionally, <strong data-start="1401" data-end="1417" style="">LED lighting</strong> in the headrest and chair body provides adjustable <strong data-start="1469" data-end="1490" style="">color temperature</strong> (4000–5000K) to enhance focus and reduce eye fatigue, based on the effect of light wavelength on cognitive performance and circadian rhythms. All smart features can be controlled and monitored via a smartphone app, making the chair an integrated system for <strong data-start="1748" data-end="1798" style="">scientifically optimized learning environments</strong>.”</font></p>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="509.83" width="412" x="965" y="77" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="su38blvhCA2a_bY0gaeY-43" parent="1" style="text;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;rounded=0;" value="<font style="font-size: 8px;" face="Courier New"><b>Developed by LEE GANGWOO</b></font>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="20" width="120" x="1270" y="670" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>

p.font: The innovative study chair integrates a posture-correction cushion, a detachable headrest, and a main chair body with multiple smart features, all designed to enhance learning efficiency.

The headrest contains active noise cancelling (ANC), which reduces surrounding noise by producing sound waves with opposite phases, demonstrating the principle of wave interference. It also includes a speaker for lectures or music, which works by converting electrical signals into vibrations that create sound waves. The temperature regulator maintains comfort by measuring temperature changes and adjusting heat, based on heat transfer principles, and a vibration motor provides tactile feedback to correct posture or deliver alarms.

The posture-correction cushion uses pressure sensors to detect how the user sits, converting applied forces into electrical signals to give AI-based feedback, helping maintain proper spinal alignment. It also has temperature control to keep the optimal range of 20–26°C for concentration. Both the cushion and headrest support Qi2 wireless charging, which works on the principle of electromagnetic induction, and are detachable for use in other locations.

Additionally, LED lighting in the headrest and chair body provides adjustable color temperature (4000–5000K) to enhance focus and reduce eye fatigue, based on the effect of light wavelength on cognitive performance and circadian rhythms. All smart features can be controlled and monitored via a smartphone app, making the chair an integrated system for scientifically optimized learning environments.”
